rulesText: Order of Merit Information Our OOM Final in 2026 will take place between 12 th to 16 th October 2026 at Enniscrone Golf Club in County Sligo, Ireland. There will be 18 players involved in a 36 Hole Event (Gross Strokeplay) and we will have a number of guest junior players from the home club at our event. OOM Final Itinerary: 12 th October – Travel Day 13 th October – Practice Day 14 th October – Round 1 Tournament Day 15 th October – Round 2 Tournament Day 16 th October – Travel Day Order of Merit - Qualification Criteria We have amended the OOM criteria for 2026 so that we have, essentially, a play off between the qualifiers from each OOM section (detailed below) and will effectively crown 4 x OOM Champions at the end of the event. Girls OOM Champion Boys Under 18 Champion Boys Under 16 Champion Boys Under 14 Champion We will have an U21 Boys OOM and a Girls Nett OOM throughout the season - but these will not qualify for the final event. Girls – 2 x U24 and 7 x U18 players will qualify (9 Girls in total) Boys – 3 x players from each Age Group (9 Boys in total) There will be No Captains picks this year – ALL qualifiers will be based on the season long OOM’s. Players must play in at least 3 x JT Events to qualify. Our event at Fraserburgh will be the last qualifying event. OOM Points will be the same as 2025 and will be given to each of the Boys Age Group Sections and the Girls U24 & U18 sections. The reduced points will remain in place for the Girls Nett OOM – and again, Gross OOM points take priority. We hope that this information will provide enough incentive for you to book your places at our events and for you to try and win your place at our OOM Final at Enniscrone – a truly remarkable venue for our OOM Final in 2026
